title: Wrap each string in an HTML tag

origin.description: Build a function that wraps every element in an HTML tag, with optional classes and inline styles.

arguments.name: class
arguments.text: CSS classes, joined with a space.

arguments.name: style
arguments.text: Named inline styles. Each name is a property.

origin.details: An empty input returns an empty character vector. The style list is written as property, colon, value, separated by semicolons.
origin.value: A function of one character vector.

translation.description: The same wrapper. class_ is the class argument, and style is a dict.

arguments.name: class_
arguments.text: One class, or a list of classes.

arguments.name: style
arguments.text: A dict of CSS properties. An empty list adds no style attribute.

translation.details: A string input returns one string. A list returns a list. An empty list returns an empty list.

name: tag_f
